lines.t: Fans waited seven years for this game, and it reportedly tripled the last one's record on Steam.
Ace Combat 8 is an arcade jet fighter game. Real planes, fast dogfights, and far more missiles than any real jet could carry.
It launched on October 2nd, for PlayStation 5, Xbox and PC.
On Steam it reportedly passed 52,000 players at once. The last game peaked at about 13,000.
This is that last game, Ace Combat 7, from 2019.

sc.label: ACE COMBAT 7 GAMEPLAY (2019)
sc.credit: Image: Bandai Namco Entertainment America, CC BY 3.0

lines.t: This time, you don't start as the pilot. You're the weapons officer in the back seat, and you take over when your pilot is killed.
The story is set in 2029, in the series' own fictional world, called Strangereal.
And it was reportedly inspired by the legend of the Ghost of Kyiv.
There are more than 30 aircraft, and the maps are built at true one to one scale.
The series turned 30 last year. The very first game came out in 1995.
Early Steam reviews were around 75 percent positive.
